about.title: About
about.intro: Haru started from Busan's shrinking population and the roughly 50% decline rate for public housing lottery winners. We show the surrounding neighborhood first, not just deposit and floor size.
about.problemBody: Supply-side notices alone don't tell citizens whether a listing sits in a neighborhood they'd want to live in. Checking nearby cafes, gyms, or convenience stores meant searching separately for every listing. Haru recommends housing by combining hard conditions with real commercial-district context.
about.bmcBlurb: A public housing and urban development corporation. Provided public rental housing data and a citizen housing-demand channel.
about.sundosoftBlurb: A GIS and data analytics company. Provided fused commercial-district and population data plus spatial analysis expertise.
